turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at twenty to five, so I need to know why my son found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of class, before anyone called me.
Thank you. Don't thank me yet. Owen found out in front of his class, and I'd like to hear why nobody called me first.
Quick question. Out of ten, how strong is a version history as evidence?
I'm not grading you, Hale. Version history isn't in this room yet, so tell me what you actually have.
Just a number. What would make it a nine?
You're asking me to help you build your case. I'm not doing that. Show me what you have, and I'll tell you what I think of it.
Pass or fail: how did I do just now?
I'm not grading you, Hale. You still haven't told me why my son found out from his phone. Start there.
